notes.title: Bug Fixes and Optimizations for the Demo Version on December 27, 2024
notes.notes:
1.Fix the issue of drawing duplicate cards from the card pack.
2.Fix the problem that the card "The Foolish Old Man" cannot have its discovered cards selected.
3.Fix the problem that when the card "Rebirth in Wrath" draws an attached card, its copy cannot be summoned.
4.Fix the problem that the number of spirit stones is not refreshed after purchasing a card pack.
5.Fix the problem that the keyword "Guard" blocks the selection of our targets.
6.Fix the situation where certain elixirs cannot be used under special circumstances.
7.Fix the problem that the second recommended deck of the fox spirit Ah Bai cannot be used.
8.Fix the problem that the cards "The Mantis That Eats Cicadas" and "Non-Aggression" cannot be crafted.
9.Fix the problem of incorrect effects of the cards "The Spirit Abyss Hunter" and "The Spirit Abyss Mystic".
10.Fix the problem that the card "The Sect Master of the Black Fiend Sect" can be triggered even during the opponent's turn.
11.Fix the problem that the minions with the keyword "Attach" in the hand, when attached to the minions on the field, do not inherit the buffs.
12.Fix the problem of card decomposition failure.
13.Fix the problem of incorrect card decomposition caused by one-click decomposition.
14.Fix the problem that the cards transformed by the card "The Spirit Fox" cannot be used.
15.Fix the problem of incorrect effect of the card "The Seven Stars' Finale" in the beginner's tutorial.
16.Fix the problem that the card "The Dragon's Roar in the Azure Sky" causes the game to freeze.
17.Optimize the difficulty of the first level of the hero trial for the fox spirit Ah Bai.
18.Fix the error prompt when clicking "Duel" in friendly battles.
19.Optimize the logic of card recommendations.
20.Optimize the usage conditions of the Double Fish Pendant in the beginner's tutorial.
21.Optimize the prompts for insufficient conditions for deck deployment.
22.Fix the problem that the heroes deployed in the ladder do not match their deployed decks.
23.Fix the text errors in the beginner's tutorial.
24.Fix the problem of incorrect display of the number of emails.

notes.title: October 15th - 16th Beta Update Notice
notes.notes:
October 16th Beta Update Announcement
Fix the effect of the Reincarnation Divine Weapon's "Passing Words" (no new additions).
In Bang Bang mode: The Night Patrol does not add health to the elemental envoys on the field.
In Bang Bang mode: Fix the abnormal settlement problem of the Ice Spirit.
In Bang Bang mode: Fix the abnormal settlement problem of the Rock Golem.
Fix the problem of incomplete reward display when claiming multiple rewards from the pass.
Fix the error in the explanatory text of Comprehension.
Fix the error of the pass task still being recorded even after completion.
Fix the incorrect target selection of "Spirit Devour".
Fix the incorrect text description of "Spirit Devour".
Fix the text error in stage six of the novice goal.
Fix the problem of the illustrations of the Hidden Leopard and the Wind-Chasing Falcon going out of frame.
Fix the problem of incomplete animation playback when the Heavenly Condemnation Falling Flame destroys an enemy hero.
Fix the situation where the hand card buff of the Spirit Gathering Divine Guard is not effective in the field aura.
Fix the problem that the achievement of "Complete 1 task" cannot be completed.

October 15th Test Update Announcement
Increase the number of "Bang Bang Adventure" attempts to 10.
Trial adjustment: Replace the Sword Case with the Sword Spirit, and change related texts, voiceovers, and configurations.
Optimize the pass tasks, and they will display normally only after playing a game.
Optimize the description of pass levels.
Fix the "Daily Login" task of the pass.
Simplify the novice goal tasks.
Optimize the description of novice goal tasks.
Fix the problem of repeated playback of trial dialogues.
Fix the damage of the Toad's natal card "Sticky Entanglement".
Fix the description problem of the Dragon Girl's celestial phenomenon.
Fix the trigger icon of the Viper's Egg Flower.
Optimize the deck in the first level of the Alchemist's trial.
Fix the problem of armor value judgment of the Heavy Armored Guard.
The Five Mysterious Sword Master may cast repeated moves.
Fix the problem that the Wraith cannot be synthesized.
Balance adjustment of the Dragon Girl's passive skill (East Sea Spiritual Water):
Water Dragon Power: After you use the hero skill, randomly give a shield to a friendly minion with an attack power less than or equal to (3).
East Sea Spiritual Water: At the end of your turn, if your minions have received healing, give them +1 attack power.
Increase the cost of the Crab General by 1.
Distributed 300 Immortal Jades (used to upgrade the pass to the deluxe version for additional enhancements).

notes.title: Demo version update notice on October 14th.
notes.notes:
1.Fixed the damage reduction special effect of the Dragon King of the East Sea.
2.Fixed the problem of blocking of PC dialogue for beginners.
3.Fixed the card prompt special effect triggered by celestial phenomena.
4.Adjusted the difficulty modification of the first three levels of the alchemist and the fifth level of the sword immortal.
5.Fixed the repeated problem of the portrait in the trial of the Dragon Girl.
6.Fixed the achievement problem of the Martial Saint.
7.Adjusted the background music of the trial.
8.Fixed the problem of some simplified characters displaying traditional characters abnormally.
9.Optimized the trial experience of the demon race.
10.Optimized the pass tasks.
11.Fixed the problem that after the Moon Shadow Sword skill of the sword immortal is broken through to the transcendent realm, it cannot be used cyclically when eliminating followers.
12.Reduced the intensity of level 25 of the bang-bang mode.
13.Sent an email with pass-unlocked resources. Fellow Taoists can go to the pass interface to view.
